t: A kingdom of south Bihar that grew from one of sixteen rival realms into the dominant power of northern India.
Its kings Bimbisara and Ajatashatru were patrons of the Buddha and Mahavira, and Rajagriha hosted the First Buddhist Council.
Its conquests and its capital Pataliputra became the core of the Nanda, Maurya and later Gupta empires.
dyk: Buddhist texts say Bimbisara once summoned the headmen of the 80,000 villages of his kingdom to an assembly, then sent them to see the Buddha.
ev: Bimbisara of the Haryanka dynasty becomes king (traditional date)
Bimbisara annexes the kingdom of Anga
Ajatashatru seizes the throne from his father
First Buddhist Council at Rajagriha (traditional date)
The Vajji league of Vaishali is conquered
Second Buddhist Council at Vaishali under Kalashoka
Mahapadma Nanda seizes the throne and founds the Nanda Empire
